speaker: Doctor
text: I'm Dr. Agent, and I see you're experiencing chronic bladder discomfort and frequent urination. To understand this better, how long have these symptoms been occurring, and do you notice any pain when you urinate or blood in your urine?

speaker: Patient
text: 40-year-old female. The patient reports a 5-month history of worsening bladder discomfort, which is relieved by voiding. She mentions an increased frequency of urination, voiding 10–15 times during the day and waking up 2–3 times at night to void. She denies any involuntary loss of urine. Attempts to manage the discomfort with reduced fluid intake and NSAIDs have provided minimal relief. She also reports recent painful intercourse.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details. To narrow down the cause, do you experience pain in the suprapubic area or lower back, and have you noticed any changes in your menstrual cycle or pelvic pressure? Additionally, do you have a history of urinary tract infections or recent sexual partners?

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Interstitial Cystitis/Bladder Pain Syndrome.

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Cystoscopy with hydrodistension.
REQUEST IMAGES: Bladder_Imaging.
